descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S08 36 h windows ±1 h (Hospital), mixed ages inside one panel, and yesterday's transcript / previous note probed up to 67 h

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it. (UAT OAT-04 Expected 1; TFA-94699 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Hospital active medication rows are deleted 36 h after their last mention: an active row not mentioned for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: active med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U6 Hospital held and stopped medication rows are deleted at 36 h, and a held row's clock restarts each time the chart is processed: a held row not refreshed for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: held/stopped med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Hospital open tasks are deleted 36 h after the chart was last processed: an open task on a chart not processed for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: open tasks)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U8 Handoffs are deleted 36 h after they were sent: a handoff sent 37 h ago is gone from the database, for sender and recipient alike. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: handoffs 36 h after sent)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T3 Hospital encounter dictation and note leave the working tabs at 18 h, are kept as yesterday's transcript / previous note until 36 h, and are then deleted. (TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: encounter, note); UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T7 Vitals, labs and imaging always show their recorded date and lab trends display as in the prototype. The display is tested in TC-13 / TC-19 (policy A); … (TFA-94699 AC 3; UAT 3.7) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). … (UAT OAT-04 Expected 2; UAT 3.7 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Patient E aged 35 h and patient L aged 37 h for: the last vitals, lab and imaging refresh; the last mention of an active row; the last refresh of a held row and the last chart processing; an open task. One handoff sent 35 h ago and one sent 37 h ago. …

When The purge runs at each probe; raw rows read with admin access

Then E: everything present. L: everything absent from the database (handoff per Q20). M: Cr, BP and the CXR gone; K, HR and the CT kept, each with its own recorded date. T: yesterday's transcript and previous note present at 35 h; 37 h judged per Q4; absent at 55 h and at 67 h

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): OAT-04 (B), UAT 3.6 and the TFA-94699 table: 35 h present and 37 h absent, per item = pass; a 35 h item gone (too early) or a 37 h item present in any form = Fail. Handoff: its text and every patient's content in it absent = pass; a surviving row may hold only the fields Q20 allows (for example sender, recipient, sentAt). …

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela / Tim.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94699 in progress

At 37 h the open task and the full handoff are still there; on a panel with one fresh value the older lab, BP and CXR stay, no value shows its own recorded date, yesterday's note is already gone at 35 h, and the bedside transcript is still on the chart at 55–100 h.

Evidence: allure 27340d48-…-result.json; retention lane. 28 checks pass, 14 fail: 11 known (K2, K3, K4, K5, and per-value recorded dates not on main), plus 4 policy conflicts (T.any55, T.any67, T2.day1at67, T2.day1at100). The transcript is kept per stay by design (transcriptArchive.ts:92-95; lifecycle.ts has no 'transcript' branch), the same conflict as dev report §3 (U17). Recorded: Q7 (one clock per panel) and Q4.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S08

36 h windows ±1 h (Hospital), mixed ages inside one panel, and yesterday's transcript / previous note probed up to 67 h

Tickets: TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane retention: status failed in retention/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (retention/plan.json, automatable: yes): API spec: E 35 h / L 37 h for vitals, lab, imaging, active row, held row (+ chart processing), open task; handoffs 35 h / 37 h; boundary charts at 36 h -1/+1 min; M with mixed ages built stepwise (Cr then K two hours ago etc.) and judged per value + recorded date (T7); T probed at 19, 35, 37, 55, 67 h by shifting the chart's clocks between purges. Patient T / T2: transcriptDate (the live transcript column's day) moves with the chart: after every step the spec sets the exact day of the tracked moment (T0 - age) with the helper's set, because a day stamp has no time of day and the helper's day shift (exact for one move of a today stamp) drifts over several steps. Transcript items still present at 55 / 67 / 100 h are judged against the UAT and tagged as a policy conflict (transcriptArchive.ts:92-95 per-stay policy; no 'transcript' branch in lifecycle.ts). — Clocks move with the helper between probes; Q4/Q7/Q20 parts recorded.

Where it ran: local

transcriptDate Sun Oct 11 2026); policy conflict) | T2.day1at67 (day-1 bedside recording 67 h after it was made (archived by the day-2 write): expected absent, got present (transcriptHistory); policy conflict) | T2.day1at100 (day-1 bedside recording 100 h after it was made: expected absent, got present (transcriptHistory); policy conflict) — policy conflict (UAT vs intended code, needs a decision): per-stay transcript policy by design: convex/lib/lifecycle.ts hospitalLifecyclePatch (108-176) has no branch for the live 'transcript' column and prunes transcriptHistory only by archivedAt (encounterArchive 48 h, :23, :167-175); convex/lib/transcriptArchive.ts:92-95 leaves archivedAt off recorded conversations on purpose ('per-stay policy (prototype :2269-2270)'). UAT 3.6 / 3.7 vs that design: needs a decision (Daniela / Tim), not a regression — record-only: M.perPanel = labsUpdatedAt=2026-10-14T05:17:22.651Z vitalsUpdatedAt=2026-10-14T05:17:22.651Z radiologyUpdatedAt=2026-10-14T05:17:22.651Z: one clock per panel [Q7 per value or per panel] | T.37 = transcript present, previous note absent [Q4 (3.6 keeps until ~54 h, the ticket table deletes at 36 h)] | T2.day2at70 = present in transcript; transcriptDate Sun Oct 11 2026 [Q4 / the per-stay transcript policy (transcriptArchive.ts:92-95) vs UAT 3.6 / 3.7] — notes: T probes (transcript kept / previous note kept / any trace): 19h {"tx":true,"note":false,"any":true,"where":["transcript","transcriptHistory"],"transcriptDate":"Tue Oct 13 2026"}, 35h {"tx":true,"note":false,"any":true,"where":["transcript","transcriptHistory"],"transcriptDate":"Tue Oct 13 2026"}, 37h {"tx":true,"note":false,"any":true,"where":["transcript","transcriptHistory"],"transcriptDate":"Tue Oct 13 2026"}, 55h {"tx":true,"note":false,"any":true,"where":["transcript","transcriptHistory"],"transcriptDate":"Mon Oct 12 2026"}, 67h {"tx":false,"note":false,"any":true,"where":["transcript"],"transcriptDate":"Sun Oct 11 2026"} | T2 archive entry for the day-1 recording: {"label":"Oct 13 (prior)","archivedAt":null} | Patient T: the chart was purged at 19 h first (the first page load after the 18 h window), as a physician who opens the app daily would; the archive stamp then counts from that purge. transcriptDate (the live transcript column's day) moved with the chart at every step: the exact day of T0 - age (T) and of the day-2 recording - age (T2), set by the spec because a day stamp has no time of day. — setup/read calls retried on the local 1 s limit: 1

Product issue: At 37 h (and 36 h + 1 min) the open task and the full handoff are still there; on a panel with a fresh value the older lab, BP and CXR (37 h old) stay, and no value carries its own recorded date; yesterday's note is already gone at 35 h. Separately, the encounter's bedside transcript is still on the chart at 55 h and 67 h, and a recording archived by the next day's recording is still there 100 h later: the code keeps recorded conversations for the whole stay on purpose (convex/lib/transcriptArchive.ts:92-95 leaves archivedAt off; hospitalLifecyclePatch in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts has no branch for the live 'transcript' column), while UAT 3.6 / 3.7 want them gone by 55 h. That part is a policy conflict for Daniela / Tim to decide, not a regression. Breaks UAT 3.6 / 3.7 ('no live Hospital patient data survives more than 36 hours'), OAT-04 (B) and Expected 2. Known in the matrix: K2, K3, per-value recorded dates are not on main, K4, K5. Policy conflict, needs a decision (not a regression): T.any55, T.any67, T2.day1at67, T2.day1at100.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation that moves a chart's stamps back, called with the local stack's admin key) and the retention-db runner, which seeds through e2e/support/backend.ts and reads the raw rows with adminQuery; dev has no admin key and the dev runner calls only the l…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
